title: Counterpoint分析师：CMT成长超预期，已成中国内地市值最大公司
speaker: MS Huahong

segments.en: But so far, the company has been growing much better than expected.
segments.zh: 但到目前为止，公司增长远超预期。

segments.en: I mean, David here, by the way, as things stand, it's already the biggest, the most valuable company in mainland China.
segments.zh: David，顺便说一句，目前它已经是中国内地最大、市值最高的公司。

segments.en: At your point, it's not been around for very long, and it's in an industry where the moat and barriers to enter are almost impossibly high to enter, yet here we are.
segments.zh: 它成立时间不长，却身处一个护城河和进入壁垒极高的行业，但我们看到了今天的成就。
